exampleDescription: Register households, then record home visits with symptoms, referrals and a photo.

app.name: Community Health Visits
app.description: Household register and home visit records

home.welcome: Register a household first, then record each home visit.

forms.title: Register household
forms.brief:
One record per household.
- Village name (text, required)
- Head of household name (text, required)
- Phone number (text, optional)
- Number of people living in the household (whole number 1 to 40, required)
- Any children under 5? Yes/No (required)
- If yes: how many children under 5 (whole number 1 to 20)
- GPS location of the house
- Consent to take part: Yes/No (required). If No, ask the reason (text).
Translate labels to Swahili.

forms.title: Home visit
forms.brief:
One record per visit.
Page 1: visit date (required), household head name (text, required).
Page 2: Is anyone sick today? Yes/No (required). If yes: which symptoms (multiple choice: fever, cough, diarrhoea, rash, other), and if other is picked ask 'Other symptom' (text). Temperature in °C (number 34 to 43, optional).
Page 3: Referred to a clinic? Yes/No (required). If yes, which clinic (text). A photo of the referral slip (optional). Notes (text, optional).
Translate labels to Swahili.
